_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Security Verification Report
summary: The Security Verification Report documents test results verifying that cryptographic principles and protective alarms in equipment meet contract requirements, supporting Government decisions on item acceptance or further development.
use_relationship:
The report contains the results of tests to verify that cryptographic principles and protective alarms embodied in equipment agree with those stipulated in the contract. It describes the tests performed and compares the results with contract performance requirements. It is used by the Government to support decisions on item acceptance or future developmental and testing requirements.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID is applicable to systems and equipment acquisitions involving cryptographic capabilities.

This DID is related to DI-QCIC-81689, Security Verification Plan and Procedures and to the Tailored Security Design and Analysis Requirements Specification that is supplied with the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the contractor's format with the following exceptions:

children.title: Page size.
children.content: The size of each finished page shall be on 8 1/2" x 11" paper (metric size A4). Drawing and illustration foldouts may be used, but must not exceed the 8 1/2" x 11" limits when folded. Photo-reduction of over-sized pages is preferred, provided such reductions are easily readable and reproducible.

children.title: Binding.
children.content: The plan shall be bound in such a manner that pages can be removed without damage or mutilation.

children.title: Change/revision identification.
children.content: Changes shall be by replacement change pages with revision changes and additions from earlier versions being identified by a solid vertical bar and applicable revision number/letter on the outside page margin. Revision deletions shall be identified by an asterisk and revision code in the outside margin.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Cover and title page.
children.content: The following information shall be included on the cover and title page:

children.title: Report document number/revision number or letter.
Program title, including program name and Telecommunications Security (TSEC) Joint Electronic Type Designation System (JETDS) number as applicable.
Revision control page.
children.content: The revision control page shall list the following information:

children.title: Table of contents.
children.content: The table of contents shall identify the following:

children.title: Title and starting page of each major section and paragraph of the report.
Page, identifying number, and title of each drawing, illustration, and figure.
Introduction.
children.content: The introduction shall include the following:

children.title: Purpose of test (as specified in the contract tasking document).
Item tested.
children.content: The items tested section shall include the following:

children.title: The equipment nomenclature, including TSEC JTEDS number, if applicable.
Functional description of the equipment.
children.content: This includes a detailed description of critical Information Assurance (IA) circuitry using flow charts, networks, and narrative as appropriate to depict time-referenced signals.

children.title: Test requirements.
children.content: The test requirements shall include the following, relating each to the prescribing contract requirement paragraph (specification, standard, plan, or work statement).

children.title: Required tests and parameters to be measured.
Performance requirements, acceptance or compliance limits, and environmental criteria.
References.
children.content: The references shall include identification of the following, as applicable:

children.title: Prior test reports on the same item.
Body of report.
children.content: The body of the report shall include the following:

children.title: Test equipment identification.
children.content: The following shall be included for each item of the test equipment used:

children.title: Test installation and setup.
children.content: This section shall include a description of the physical setup for conducting the tests. Drawings and photographs may be used for clarification. The following shall be identified:

children.title: Trigger mechanism or signal and appropriate timing information (sample period, etc.)
Test procedures.
children.content: This section shall include an outline of the procedures followed in conducting the test. If these procedures are contained in a previously delivered document, reference that document in lieu of repeating its contents. These procedures shall address:

children.title: Summarized sequence of testing steps, including a description of how the test item was operated during test, and any control conditions imposed.
Recorded data.
children.content: Copies of actual recorded data (i.e., log book entries, oscillographs, instrument readings, plotter graphs). If these are extensive, provide in an appendix.

children.title: Test results.
children.content: The test results shall include the following:

children.title: A complete description of the data provided.
Matrices, tables, graphs comparing results achieved against performance objectives or requirements.
children.content: Includes a discussion of these as to their significance, and how they compare to any prior tests. Explain how and where the trigger signal is relative to the desired data.

children.title: Calculation examples with all associated assumptions and parameters.
Tabulations of reduced data from 4.a, identified to the related test procedure generating the data.
Discussion of anomalies, deviations, discrepancies or failures; their impact, causes, and proposed corrective actions.
Conclusions.
children.content: The conclusions shall include statements addressing the following (distinguish between opinion and subjective):

children.title: Effectiveness of the test in measuring tests item performance.
Success or failure of the test item to meet required performance objectives.
The need for repeat, additional, or alternative testing.
The need for test item re-design or further development.
Recommendations.
children.content: The recommendations shall refer to the appropriate test results and conclusions drawn. These could address such actions as:
